explanation: Close fast encounter of bodies 0 and 1 (distance ~1.22 at step 89, substeps 8 per step) causes leapfrog integration error with dt=0.0143: momentum conserved until step 85 (identical to initial) then drifts at steps 88-89, violating momentum_conserved by 0.16 vs 0.126 allowed. Halving dt removes violation, confirming inadequate substep refinement for strong-acceleration/fast-motion regime breaks exact momentum conservation (pairwise forces no longer equal-opposite at discrete level).
